title: The Watering Hole
text: At dusk every beast of the plains comes to drink at one pool, lions beside antelope, wolves beside deer, keeping a truce for an hour. The water is pink in the sunset. No one has ever seen what happens when the hour is up.

options.label: Drink with the beasts and keep the truce as they do.

outcomes.text: The beasts let you be. You have never felt so watched, or so safe.
Something does not keep the truce.

options.label: The sharpest watches which beasts come, to learn what roams ahead.

outcomes.text: You learn what hunts the road ahead.

options.label: Break the truce while they drink; they will never be easier prey.

outcomes.text: The kills are easy at first. The plains remember.
